let Column := Nat → Bool
let extend (x : Nat) : Nat :=
  let b (i : Nat) := (x >>> i) &&& 1
  x ||| ((b 0 ||| b 1) <<< 26) ||| ((b 3 ||| b 9) <<< 27)
let pos (i : Nat) := extend (positive[i]!)
let neg (i : Nat) := extend (negative[i]!)
let input (j : Nat) : Column := fun r =>
  (if r < 52 then pos r else neg (r-52)).testBit j
let mix (op : Bool) (a b : Column) : Column := fun r =>
  if op then a r && b r else a r || b r
let base (i : Fin 30) : Column :=
  if i.val < 28 then input i.val
  else if i.val = 28 then mix true (input 15) (input 27)
  else mix true (input 17) (input 26)
let wire (s : List Column) (i : Nat) := s.getD i (fun _ => false)
let fixed (k : Fin 32) : Column :=
  if h : k.val < 30 then base ⟨k.val,h⟩
  else if k.val = 30 then mix true (input 13) (input 26) else mix true (input 13) (input 27)
let guardsList : List (Fin 32 × Fin 32) := [(2,6)]
let cheap (g : Bool × Nat × Nat) := g.1 && (g.2.1 == 32 || g.2.2 == 32)
let step (s : List Column) (g : Bool × Nat × Nat) :=
  if g.1 then s ++ [fun r => wire s g.2.1 r && wire s g.2.2 r]
  else s ++ [fun r => wire s g.2.1 r || wire s g.2.2 r]
let G := Bool × Nat × Nat
let value (s : List Column) (g : G) (r : Nat) :=
  if g.1 then wire s g.2.1 r && wire s g.2.2 r else wire s g.2.1 r || wire s g.2.2 r
let possible (pred : G → Bool) (s : List Column) (g : G) := ∃ alt : G, pred alt = true ∧ ∀ r : Fin 520, value s alt r.val = value s g r.val
let free (g : G) := !g.1 || cheap g
let credit (s : List Column) (g : G) : Nat := by
  classical
  exact if possible Prod.fst s g ∧ possible free s g then 1 else 0
let auditStep (state : List Column × Nat) (g : G) := (step state.1 g,state.2 + credit state.1 g)
let codes : Array Nat := #[0, 1369, 1, 26, 1395, 1400, 1402, 1404, 38, 1407, 1430, 63, 1432, 1437, 70, 1439, 76, 1445, 80, 1471, 1473, 1474, 106, 1476, 114, 1483, 120, 138, 1507, 1510, 1513, 1514, 152, 1521, 1546, 1547, 1548, 1550, 190, 1559, 1582, 1583, 1584, 1585, 1587, 1588, 228, 1597, 1619, 1621, 1622, 254, 1624, 266, 1635, 1657, 1658, 1659, 1661, 304, 1673, 1695, 1696, 1698, 1700, 342, 1711, 360, 1729, 1732, 1735, 1736, 380, 1749, 1769, 1770, 1772, 418, 1787, 1804, 1806, 1807, 1809, 1810, 456, 1825, 1843, 1844, 1846, 1848, 494, 1863, 1876, 1877, 1878, 1879, 511, 1880, 512, 1881, 1883, 532, 1901, 1916, 1917, 1918, 1920, 570, 1939, 1951, 583, 1952, 1954, 1955, 1957, 589, 1958, 608, 1977, 1991, 1992, 1994, 1995, 1996, 646, 2015, 2024, 658, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2031, 684, 2053, 2064, 2065, 2066, 2068, 2069, 2070, 722, 2091, 2100, 2102, 2103, 2105, 2106, 2107, 760, 2129, 2139, 2140, 2142, 798, 2167, 2174, 2176, 2177, 2179, 836, 2205, 2211, 2213, 2214, 2216, 874, 2243, 2250, 2251, 2253, 2254, 2255, 912, 2281, 2286, 2287, 2288, 921, 2290, 950, 2319, 2324, 2325, 2327, 960, 2329, 988, 2357, 991, 2360, 992, 2361, 2362, 995, 2364, 1026, 2395, 1027, 2396, 2398, 1030, 2399, 2401, 2402, 1064, 2433, 2435, 2436, 2438, 2439, 1102, 2471, 2472, 2473, 2475, 1140, 2509, 2510, 2512, 2513, 2514, 1178, 2547, 2549, 2550, 2551, 1216, 1218, 1219, 1254, 2623, 2624, 2625, 1292, 2661, 1330, 2699]
let decode (c : Nat) : Bool × Nat × Nat := (decide (1369 ≤ c),c / 37 % 37,c % 37)
(∀ (gs : List (Bool × Nat × Nat)) (o : Nat),
  let pool := step (step (List.ofFn fixed) (false,2,6)) (true,1,24)
  (∀ p : Fin 52, wire (gs.foldl step pool) o p.val = true) →
  (∀ j : Fin 468, wire (gs.foldl step pool) o (52+j.val) = false) →
  35 + (gs.foldl auditStep (pool,0)).2 ≤ 8 + gs.length) →
∀ (i : Fin 237) (gs : List (Bool × Nat × Nat)) (o : Nat),
  let start := step (step (List.ofFn fixed) (false,2,6)) (true,1,24)
  let front := [(true,15,32),(true,25,32),decode codes[i.val]!]
  let pool := front.foldl step start
  (∀ p : Fin 52, wire (gs.foldl step pool) o p.val = true) →
  (∀ j : Fin 468, wire (gs.foldl step pool) o (52+j.val) = false) →
  38 + gs.countP cheap ≤ 11 + gs.length
